name: blotato-automations
title_zh: 先查清平台规则再动手的 Blotato 自动化研究集
tagline_zh: 别人直接给你一串能跑的发布脚本，这里先摊开每个平台的限流、审核和封号边界，再决定自动化值不值得做。
tagline_en: Instead of handing you publish scripts, it lays out each platform's rate limits, review rules and ban boundaries.
desc_en: Research and infrastructure for quality-first Blotato content automations
why_zh: 质量优先意味着先做功课：把平台约束、失败案例和基建选型摆出来，再谈自动化。
why_en: Quality-first means homework first: platform constraints, failure cases and infra choices are laid out before any automation.
limit_zh: 这是研究资料和基建笔记，不是开箱即用的发布工具；没有现成 Blotato 账号和 API key 的话。
limit_en: Research notes and infra, not a ready-to-run publisher; without a Blotato account and API key you only get judgment criteria, no automation.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Blotato automation research that checks platform rules first
